input.title: [Mobile] Undo applies stale bullet color
input.body:
Tested on iOS Safari and Android

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create a new thought
2. Reload to clear the undo stack
3. Type 'A' in thought
4. Apply blue background color
5. Close keyboard
6. Undo twice

## Expected behavior

Bullet stays white when text is cleared from thought.

## Current behavior

Bullet returns to stale background color when text is cleared
